preferences.title: Presentation
preferences.description: How Cordial asks Vulkan to present frames. Uncapped prefers mailbox where the driver offers it, and falls back to immediate. Leave it on Uncapped unless you are chasing tearing or battery.

options.label: Locked to the display (what the engine asks for)

preferences.title: Frame rate cap
preferences.description: The highest frame rate Roblox will render. Roblox stops at 60 on its own; pick your monitor's refresh rate to match it.
